It sounds incredibly frustrating to deal with racing thoughts and struggle to focus all day. While everyone gets distracted sometimes, having so many thoughts that it constantly disrupts your day isn't something you just have to force yourself to "deal with." Because I am an AI, I cannot diagnose you with ADHD, but the overwhelming feelings you are describing are very real and definitely worth exploring further. You deserve support when your brain feels this exhausting. 

Since your teacher noticed your struggles, they might be a great person to talk to again. You could also reach out to a school counselor or a doctor. They can help you figure out exactly what is going on and might even be able to help explain it to your dad. You don't have to figure this out all on your own, and whether it is ADHD or something else, there are tools and strategies that can help make things easier for you.
